primitives.name: Odds API Data Validation
primitives.verbatim_quote: All game data must have `commence_time` in the future (or < 3hr ago for live) 2.
primitives.assumptions: ['Data originates from trusted external API sources', 'Temporal consistency enforced through UTC timestamps', 'Live window capped at 3 hours to filter stale data']

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's event timestamp filtering pipeline, ensuring only relevant data enters the probabilistic inference stack.
layer2.telemetry: Rate of rejected events per hour, indicating API freshness

primitives.name: Ingestion Run Traceability
primitives.verbatim_quote: All picks must trace back to an ingestion run ID 4.
primitives.assumptions: ['Each pick is uniquely identifiable within a batch context', 'Backwards compatibility with historical processing', 'Auditability for reproducible analysis']
primitives.breakdown_regime: Loss of traceability triggers reprocessing flag

layer2.mapping: Establishes causal links between raw ingestions and derived predictions, enabling GSE's state-transition accountability.
layer2.telemetry: Number of orphaned picks, signaling potential data corruption

primitives.name: Ingestion Run Logging
primitives.verbatim_quote: All ingestion runs logged with status, record count, duration, errors
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'status': 'Boolean success indicator', 'N_{records}': 'Count of processed records', '\\Delta t': 'Duration of ingestion process', 'errors': 'Count of encountered exceptions'}
primitives.assumptions: ['Structured logging format adheres to ELK stack requirements', 'Metrics are persisted to time-series database for monitoring', 'Error counts trigger automated alerting thresholds']
primitives.breakdown_regime: Excessive error rates cause system-wide degradation

layer2.mapping: Derives performance metrics that feed into GSI's model validation pipelines, assessing robustness under varying loads.
layer2.telemetry: Mean time between failures (MTBF) for ingestion batches

primitives.name: Model Catalog Source of Truth
primitives.verbatim_quote: The model catalog / source of truth > is `apps/web/lib/claude-api/model-router.ts`, whose `MODELS` map defines the > exact ids: `haiku = "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001"`, > `sonnet = "claude-sonnet-4-6"`, `opus = "claude-opus-4-8"`.
primitives.assumptions: ['Models are immutable once registered in the routing table', 'Versioning follows semantic naming conventions', 'Only listed models can be invoked by the system']
primitives.breakdown_regime: Unrecognized model IDs cause runtime configuration errors

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE's agent selection layer, where different LLM variants serve distinct reasoning tasks based on computational budget.
layer2.telemetry: Invocation frequency per model, highlighting resource allocation efficiency
